name: mnemonic PassiveDNS v3 (Argus API)
tier_rationale: Established security company with a public API, documentation and a business offering (A8 trusted); P015 cond 2 records 'mnemonic pDNS v3 keyless (public TLP:CLEAR records, tier trusted)'.

reliability.justification: Sensor-based passive DNS (records carry first/last seen and TLP:CLEAR markings); anonymous offset-0 pages come back masked (no timestamps, every rrtype 'a', flag partialResult: observed 2026-11-26), so those timestamps are approximate database times.

error_markers.reason: mnemonic PassiveDNS: rate limited (responseCode 429 in the response envelope)
mnemonic PassiveDNS: anonymous quota exhausted (responseCode 402 in the response envelope)
mnemonic PassiveDNS: ERROR message in an HTTP 200 envelope

mnemonic.description: mnemonic Argus API key (header Argus-API-Key): raises the anonymous PassiveDNS quota
mnemonic.plan_hint: the team's own mnemonic account; sent only in the Argus-API-Key header, never in a URL

pdns.title: mnemonic PassiveDNS v3 GET /pdns/v3/{domain_or_ip}?limit=25&offset={n} (first/last seen, rrtype, TLP per record)

terms.quote: mnemonic pDNS v3 keyless (public TLP:CLEAR records, tier trusted) is classed open only once legal records its terms with evidence (legal_dpo: recorded before the corporate default); until then it is skipped under the corporate profile with reason_code 'licence'.

pdns.notes: Quote: binding council text (P015 cond 2). Provisional class 'license' (business use waits for legal's recorded terms: a licence_allow entry with the terms evidence clears it, after which legal reclassifies the source 'open'); it keeps the module's terms 'noncommercial' set by the Robtex feed. Research C0015: limit <= 25 per page, offset pagination (capped at 4 pages, P015 cond 4), epoch-millisecond timestamps; anonymous answers ~100 requests/day per IP (unverified, budget 80/day); count 997 for example.com. The web deep link passivedns.mnemonic.no/search returned 404: no manual link.
pdns.licensed_alternative: A licence_allow entry recording mnemonic's PassiveDNS terms (or a company Argus API account), after which legal reclassifies the source 'open'.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G01-2 (P015, module passive_dns). Markers derive from the Argus response envelope (responseCode, messages[].type); an HTTP 429/402 status is classified by the core as well.
